if (parts.length === 0) delete out[control.field];
  else out[control.field] = parts.join(',');
killedBy: stepMultiset clears the parameter when the last one is removed, rather than emitting empty
why: Removing the last tank has to CLEAR the parameter, not emit `tanks=`. An empty value is a value the parser must then reject, so the menu would build a URL carrying a rejected parameter and show its own rejection note -- for the state that means 'I chose nothing', which every other control expresses by absence.
